notes: Best for a temporary de-puffed look.

benefits.concern: puffiness / tired look around the eyes
benefits.mechanism: Caffeine is a vasoconstrictor that transiently narrows superficial blood vessels and supports fluid movement, reducing the look of puffiness.
benefits.what_it_means: Temporarily reduces the look of puffiness and gives a tighter, more awake appearance.

benefits.mechanism: Caffeine is a methylxanthine antioxidant that helps scavenge reactive oxygen species at the skin surface.
benefits.what_it_means: Adds antioxidant support against daily oxidative stress.

evidence.summary: Vasoconstrictor de-puffing and antioxidant activity are established cosmetic functions of caffeine; graded C (ingredient function).

overview: Caffeine is a fast-penetrating ingredient prized for a temporary de-puffing, tightening look around the eyes and for antioxidant support.

ingredient.what_it_is: A small, fast-penetrating molecule used mainly around the eyes for a temporarily de-puffed, tightened look, plus antioxidant support.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: It can temporarily reduce the look of puffiness and give a tighter appearance, which softens shadowing — but it does not remove pigment-based or structural dark circles.
